summary: 5-axis code review: fix is correct, well-scoped, well-documented, well-tested. No blocking findings. Three low-severity advisories, two applied in-line (call dedup, UTF-8 round-trip test), one tracked as an out-of-scope disclosed follow-up (cmd.exe auto-execute path unproven).

review.finding: cmd.exe is left on the plain qCmd() path (raw \n embedded in the quoted argument), and cmd.exe is a real, user-selectable auto-execute target (pty-manager.ts ShellKind/WHITELIST includes cmd/cmd.exe alongside pwsh), not just a manual copy-paste convenience. Interactive cmd.exe has no multi-line quote-buffering the way PowerShell's parser does, so this is a disclosed, unproven gap consistent with this bug's stated PowerShell-only scope.
review.suggestion: File a fast follow-up to empirically verify (or fix) the cmd.exe auto-execute path the same way this fix verified PowerShell.
review.disposition: accepted-and-deferred: documented as an out-of-scope, disclosed follow-up in the iterate ADR rather than blocking this PowerShell-scoped fix (reported bug is PowerShell-specific; expanding scope to an unreported/unreproduced cmd.exe issue would be speculative).

review.finding: buildCodexPrompt(args) was called twice in source inside the ternary.
qPsMultiline's doc comment claims correctness for non-ASCII/multi-byte UTF-8 content, unpinned by any test fixture.
review.suggestion: Add a round-trip test case with a multi-byte character.
